description: Converts a credit rating to a common numeric rank. Look up the scale first, then the rating. 1 is the best rating and 22 is default, so a lower number is better.
notes: Ranks 1-10 are investment grade; 11-21 are speculative grade; 22 is default.
The scale keys match the allowed values of borrower.rank ('S&P', 'Moody', 'Fitch').
Moody's has no default grade; its lowest grade, C, is rank 21.
Fitch uses a single CCC grade, mapped to rank 18. S&P 'SD' and Fitch 'RD' map to 22.
NR (not rated) and WD (withdrawn) have no rank and must be handled separately.
Internal rating scales are not included; add a scale for them if you use one.
